summary: P3B Operator View (tablet/desktop) tested end-to-end. Backend: 106/106 pytest GREEN with -n 0 (includes new TestP3BOperatorProgress: 10 tests passing — empty-initial GET, check updates summary, all-steps -> completed=true, uncheck clears checked_by/checked_at, idempotent upsert, QC GET allowed, QC POST 403, unauth 401, WO 404, isolation across WOs). Frontend: full operator UX verified for Production (redi) and QC (leni). Routes /operator/work-orders/{wo} and /operator/work-orders/{wo}/bundles/{code} render fullscreen dark layout (no sidebar/navbar). Bundle cards A..J render, click navigates correctly. Checkbox flow: 0/5 -> click step 1 -> 1/5 -> uncheck -> 0/5 -> re-check -> reload page -> persists 1/5. All 5 steps -> operator-bundle-complete 'SELESAI' badge shown; bundle A operator-bundle-done-A badge shown on WO page. Prev/Next nav: prev disabled at A, next -> B works. Entry points: wo-open-operator-mode and bundle-open-operator-mode buttons on regular pages navigate correctly. Exit link 'Kembali ke tampilan normal' returns to /work-orders/{wo}. Photo galleries: bundle-photo-root + step-photo-1-root render with thumbs; click thumb -> operator-bundle-photo-lightbox opens; click lightbox -> closes. QC (leni): step checkbox shows 'cursor-not-allowed' + 'opacity-60' classes, 'Hanya lihat' badge visible, click does NOT change progress (5/5 stayed 5/5). GET operator-progress still 200 for QC.

issues: QC checkbox uses CSS-only disable (cursor-not-allowed + opacity-60 classes) without the HTML 'disabled' attribute on the <button>. Click still propagates but the onClick handler short-circuits via canCheck check. Functionally correct (no POST is made) but the button remains focusable/clickable from accessibility perspective. Recommend adding `disabled={!canCheck}` to the button element for proper a11y.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Add native `disabled` HTML attribute on operator-step-check-{n} button when canCheck is false (for accessibility / screen readers). The functional read-only enforcement already works via the onClick guard.
critical_code_review_comments: OperatorWorkOrder.jsx and OperatorBundle.jsx are well-structured, fully dark themed (slate-900), and properly NOT wrapped in Layout — fullscreen as required. testIds match spec exactly.

Backend POST /api/work-orders/{wo}/operator-progress correctly upserts on (wo_number, bundle_code, step_number) with unique index, sets checked_by + checked_at, and clears them on uncheck. RBAC enforced (QC -> 403 on write, allowed on read).
Photo gallery component OperatorPhotoGallery uses fixed z-50 lightbox with click-outside close. Thumbnail testIds follow operator-bundle-photo-thumb-{id} pattern correctly.
Minor a11y: step checkbox button uses className-based disable instead of native disabled attr. Click handler guards it, but a screen reader sees it as enabled.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all P3B UI flows verified for Production + QC)
